short_description: The water tanks of the International Space Station, live: urine, waste water and clean water.
description:
Live telemetry from the ISS on your desk.

## What you see

- The three tanks side by side: urine, waste water and clean water, each with its level.
- Turn the wheel to see one tank on the whole screen: clean water sloshes in blue, urine in yellow with rising bubbles, and waste water is a heap of garbage as tall as its level.

## Data

NASA's public ISS telemetry (ISSLIVE) through Lightstreamer, no key needed, checked every five minutes.
changelog: First release: the urine, waste water and clean water tanks, each also on the whole screen.
